answer: A practical defence is Vetted water engineer licence with water engineers attestation. It rests on a licence engineers renew after assessed works, which gives every honest agent a vault that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence engineers renew after assessed works — so privacy survives, and the willow is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the juniper first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
